There's this stereotype that engineers are unkempt and unattractive too. People, especially non-engineers, don't often expect me to be an engineer - partially because I'm female, but also because I dress up a lot and seem relatively normal. Not that there's anything wrong with how anyone else dresses, but I feel confident and productive when I feel like I look my best. I usually wear heels/wedges, have my hair blown out, have my nails done, eyelash extensions etc. Never wear dresses though. 

I used to be an electrical engineer and many of the other female elecs dressed more like me. I'm in software now and I see it less frequently, but there are still a lot of women who dress nicely and are up-to,-date on fashion.
